2021.change_reason: Adds explicit diversity, equity and inclusion language ('Speaking out for diversity, equity and inclusion'), employee demographics (16,000 people, 82 languages, 38 countries) and stakeholder segments with sustainability and inclusive-economy pillars.
2021.analyst_notes: Aspirational and purpose-led, with a four-part values list (put savings to work, innovate, challenge each other, speak out for DEI). The headcount and language statistics add concreteness.

2022.analyst_notes: Heavier use of narrative and transcripts, and the climate commitment is concrete. Much of the framing is question-driven ('how can we...'), which reads as aspirational rather than declarative. The 'What's Your Why' employee quotes carry most of the people-culture content.
